domicile_at_pin: With client scoping enabled, application argv is wrapped in a systemd user scope under app.slice. Without a requested scope, the spawn helper keeps the original argv; the launcher passes scope-clients conditionally.
System limits and the RTKit service belong to system configuration; a standalone Home Manager configuration does not grant them.

An initial module-evaluation error propagates before desktop setup. Live module reevaluation stages and renames a replacement only after successful evaluation; raw JSON configuration follows a separate path. Visible error presentation remains unqualified.
SIGINT and SIGTERM handlers set the launcher stop marker. The stopped outcome maps to a nonzero exit status at the desktop entry point; this states source control flow.

The launcher prepares the compositor environment with BROWSER set to its browser helper and runtime shims prepended to inherited PATH. This states environment construction without establishing URL-handler choice or successful client launch.

After compositor loss, recoverable SDK subscriptions register under a new call identifier. Streams carrying a missed-events marker report that intervening changes were not heard; this does not establish complete application-state restoration.
The launcher routes HTTP and HTTPS addresses directly to a browser window before considering a MIME application.
